input: Sign up for a wilderness first responder course

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: WFR courses vary significantly in certification level — WFA (Wilderness First Aid, 2 days), WAFA, WEMT, or full WFR (8-10 days). The target certification level changes which courses to look for entirely.
The user may have a hard deadline (a trip, a job requirement, a season start) that narrows which course dates are viable.
WFR courses are offered in-person at specific locations. Knowing the user's region or willingness to travel determines which providers are even accessible.
Whether this is for personal skill-building, a specific employer, or a volunteer organization affects which certifying body (NOLS, SOLO, WMA, etc.) is acceptable or required.
Full WFR courses range from ~$700 to $1,000+. Knowing the budget determines whether to prioritize cost, filter out options, or look for scholarships and subsidized programs.
The user may want help comparing course providers, filling out an actual registration form, or just getting a shortlist of options — this determines the very next step in the plan.
Some providers offer hybrid (online lectures + in-person skills), field-based, or classroom-heavy formats. The user's learning preference or schedule flexibility may strongly favor one style.

gold.taskTitle: Sign up for a wilderness first responder course
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to find and enroll in a Wilderness First Responder (WFR) course.

questions.title: Which certification level are you aiming for?
questions.description: Is the goal a short Wilderness First Aid (WFA, ~2 days), the full Wilderness First Responder (WFR, ~8-10 days), or a higher level like Wilderness EMT?

questions.title: Do you have a deadline this must be completed by?
questions.description: Is there a specific trip, job start date, or season that the certification needs to be in hand before?

questions.title: What region or city are you based in?
questions.description: Knowing your location determines which course providers and venues are realistically accessible to you.

questions.title: Is this for a specific employer, organization, or personal use?
questions.description: Some employers or volunteer roles require certification from a particular provider (e.g., NOLS, SOLO, WMA). This determines which certifying body must be used.

questions.title: What is your budget for the course?
questions.description: Full WFR courses typically cost $700–$1,000+. Knowing your budget helps filter options or flag scholarships and employer reimbursement programs.

questions.title: What do you need help with most right now?
questions.description: Should the plan focus on comparing providers, identifying open course dates, or walking through the actual registration process step by step?

questions.title: Do you prefer a field-based, classroom, or hybrid course format?
questions.description: Some courses are run entirely outdoors in field settings, others mix online pre-work with in-person skills days. Your schedule and learning style may favor one format.
